caption:
Robbers threw her off a moving train for her gold chain. Two years later, she stood on top of the world.

Arunima Sinha lost her leg that night in 2011. She could have stopped there - most people would have. Instead she trained at the Nehru Institute of Mountaineering and summited Everest in 2013, the first female amputee to do it. She's since climbed six of the world's highest peaks. The leg didn't get a vote in what came next.
